findings.message: The sgpd box at 0xFC lies in a edts box; sample groups belong in a stbl or traf box (ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.9), so it is shown but does not describe the track's samples.
The sbgp box at 0x12C lies in a edts box; sample groups belong in a stbl or traf box (ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.9), so it is shown but does not describe the track's samples.
The samples of the audio track 1 are encrypted (Common Encryption, AES-CTR (cenc)), so their frames are not read; the stream is described by its sample entry and sample tables.
